Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Customer ID defined by the firms. Maximum length is 16 characters. For XMGE products up to 16 characters are passed through for clearing; for XMFE products up to 10 characters.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Day unique identifier of the order as assigned by the firm. 20 characters or less. ASCII 33-126 allowed, except pipe. Validated unique across all open orders for the session within a matching engine.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts specified on the order. Whole number equal to or greater than 1. Maximum size defined in Product Reference Guide and/or configured per session.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Valid values: 1 = Market Order, 2 = Limit Order, 3 = Stop-Market Order, 4 = Stop-Limit Order, K = Market-Limit Order, k = Market Order with Protection, s = Stop-Market Order with Protection.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price for Limit and Stop-Limit orders. Ignored for order types 1, 3, K, k, and s. Trailing zeros allowed up to nine digits. Zero and negative prices supported. Price precision 7.9. Min/max price defined by Product Reference Guide.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order. Valid values: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Onyx Instrument ID.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Firms may use this field to transmit instructions for clearing. The first 20 characters are passed to clearing systems unchanged. ASCII 33-126 allowed, except pipe.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Specifies how long the order remains in effect.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the order was initiated/released expressed in UTC. Format: YYYYMMDD-HH:MM:SS.uuu

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Valid values: O = Open (default), C = Close.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Trigger price. Required for OrdType = 3, 4, or s; ignored otherwise.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum fill quantity. Must be greater than 1 to be a MinQty order.

Field.Name: CustomerOrFirm
Field.Description: Valid values: 0 = Customer, 1 = Firm.

Field.Name: ExpireDate
Field.Description: Required if TimeInForce (59) = 6 (GTD). Date of order expiration, expressed in terms of the Business Trade Date. Format: YYYYMMDD.

Field.Name: ManualOrderIndicator
Field.Description: Valid values: Y = Manual, N = Automated.

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Customer order handling instructions.

Field.Name: SideClearingTradePriceType
Field.Description: Clearing trade price type for the side.

Field.Name: PurgeGroup
Field.Description: Optional Trading Participant specified alphanumeric value 0-9, A-Z, or a-z.

Field.Name: SelfTradeProtection
Field.Description: Self-trade protection group (optional). Trading Participant specified alphanumeric value 0-9, A-Z, or a-z. Space not supported in the 3rd or 4th position.

Field.Name: TradingCollarDollarValue
Field.Description: Custom Dollar Value for Trading Collar Protection. When not present or zero/negative, exchange default is used.

Field.Name: CtiCode
Field.Description: Customer Type Indicator. Valid values: 1 = CTI 1 (own account), 2 = CTI 2 (proprietary account of a clearing member), 3 = CTI 3 (personal account of another market participant), 4 = CTI 4 (any transaction not meeting CTI 1, 2 or 3).
